sara: Quick sync: proposing a small refactor for pagination surface. Two primitives: FetchPage (unary) and IteratePages (iterator/async iterable). Keep transport retries confined to FetchPage.

tom: 👍 keeps things composable. How do we handle idempotency semantics for IteratePages?

sara: IteratePages will call FetchPage and apply SDK-level resume only at opaque next_page_token boundaries. We won't attempt item-level resume unless server advertises per-item cursors.

lee: Transport question: default to HTTP/JSON for parity. gRPC stream allowed as opt-in for Go with same Transport interface.

ani: Edge cases: partial page parse failure -> surface PageParseError and stop. Default page is atomic. We can add an experimental "partial_ok" flag later.

sara: Migration plan: add FetchPage + IteratePages, keep old iterator as shim for 3 months, then deprecate. We'll include examples for TS/Python/Go in the RFC addendum.

ci-bot: deploy-bot: RFC PR #4312 created. Compatibility checks queued.
